notes: Allowed until 2026-07-27, one pass after fixture 22 fixed the same class of bug. Fixture 22 made the PII evaluator scan retrieved sources; it scanned source.snippet and stopped there, while the README described the scope as 'the response, or any retrieved source'. A document's title and url ARE the retrieved source: a title reaches the model exactly the way a body does, and an API key in a query string is a leak wherever it sits. Both content evaluators now share evaluators/base.py::scan_targets so the scope cannot drift apart again.
